title: So Easy (To Fall In Love)
rawTtml:
I could be the twist, the one to make you stop我可以是那个转折点，那个让你驻足的人

The icing on your cake, the cherry on the top是你蛋糕上的糖霜，顶端的那颗樱桃

It's heaven in my heart, and we could find you some space, mmm我心中藏着天堂，我们可以为你腾出一点空间

I could be the world to you, the missing piece我可以成为你的全世界，那块缺失的拼图

That extra sentimental kind of chemistry那种格外感性、浪漫的化学反应

Some people make it hard, with me, that isn't the case有些人让相处变得困难，但在我这里，完全不是那样

'Cause I make it so easy to fall in love因为我让坠入爱河是如此简单

So come give me a call, and we'll fall into us所以给我打个电话吧，我们会陷入彼此的温柔

I'm the perfect mix of Saturday night and the rest of your life我是周六夜晚的狂欢与你余生安稳的完美结合

Anyone with a heart would agree任何有心的人都会赞同

It's so easy这是如此简单

To fall in love with与我坠入爱河

The way I do my hair, the way I make you laugh爱上我打理头发的样子，我逗你发笑的样子

The way we like to share a walk in Central Park还有我们喜欢在中央公园散步的时光

I could be fresh air, might be the girl of your dreams我可以是新鲜的空气，也可能是你的梦中女孩(Dream, dream, dream, dream)梦境，梦境，梦境，梦境

There's no need to hide if you're into me如果你也对我动心，就不必隐藏

'Cause I'm into you quite intimately因为我也在深深地迷恋着你

And maybe one night could turn into three也许一个夜晚可以变成三个

Well, I'm down to see我很愿意看看接下来的发展

'Cause I make it so easy to fall in love因为我让坠入爱河是如此简单

So come give me a call, and we'll fall into us所以给我打个电话吧，让我们坠入情网

I'm the perfect mix of Saturday night and the rest of your life我是周六夜晚与往后余生的完美契合

Anyone with a heart would agree任何有心的人都会赞同

It's so easy这是如此简单

To fall in love with me与我坠入爱河(Me, me)我，我

Me me我，我
